-> each input has correct output (e.g., for every new input instance there must exist the correct output -> for dog img to detect there must be already dog image in training dataset
The model compares its predictions with actual results and improves over time to increase accuracy.

1. classification -> where the output is categorical
2. Regression -> where output is continuous variable

steps for working:
1. collect data with labels 
2. split the data - train & test
3. train the model
4. validate and test the model on test data
5. deploy the model for unseen data
